entries.title: Genesis 37:2
segments: Sons of Bilhah, and--Zilpah; Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
Their evil report; Joseph made known to Jacob their evil conduct.

entries.title: Genesis 37:3
segments:
Coat of many colors; as a mark of distinction, and an expression of his father's love. 
 
Parents in the treatment of their children need wisdom from above, and should carefully avoid making invidious distinctions between them.

entries.title: Genesis 37:4
segments: Could not; for want of disposition, not of power; they chose not to do it.

entries.title: Genesis 37:7
segments: Made obeisance; bowed down; a common mode of expressing subjection.

entries.title: Genesis 37:8
segments: Children who are especially favored need much wisdom, in order not needlessly to increase the difficulty which the partiality of parents occasions.

entries.title: Genesis 37:9
segments: Sun--moon and--eleven stars; referring to Joseph's father, mother, and eleven brethren.

entries.title: Genesis 37:11
segments:
Observed the saying; remembered it, and reflected much upon its meaning. 
 
God's dealings with children are full of instruction, and worthy of being carefully observed and seriously pondered by parents.

entries.title: Genesis 37:17
segments: Dothan; twelve or fifteen miles north of Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 37:18
segments: Envy tends to make men hard-hearted and cruel, to root out even natural affection, and awaken the most malignant and murderous passions.

entries.title: Genesis 37:22
segments: That he might rid him out of their hands; prevent their killing him, and restore him again to his father.

entries.title: Genesis 37:24
segments:
Into a pit; that is, a cistern underground.  Such cisterns are used now, as anciently, to hold water, and some of them are of great size. 
 
Great favors of Providence are often accompanied or followed by great trials.

entries.title: Genesis 37:28
segments: Midianites--Ishmaelites; it seems to have been a mixed company, made up of Ishmaelites, descendants of Ishmael, and Midianites, descendants of Midian, Abraham's fourth son by Keturah.  Hence they are called now by one name, now by the other.

entries.title: Genesis 37:29
segments: Rent his clothes; a common way in the East of expressing deep grief.

entries.title: Genesis 37:30
segments: The child is not; Reuben was probably absent when they sold Joseph.

entries.title: Genesis 37:32
segments: Under the influence of envy or covetousness, men may sell even their own brother into perpetual bondage, and rend the heart of an affectionate father with exquisite anguish.  But in doing it, they are preparing for exquisite anguish themselves.

entries.title: Genesis 37:33
segments: Joseph is--rent in pieces; Jacob, who deceived his father, is now himself woefully deceived by his children.

entries.title: Genesis 37:34
segments: Sackcloth; a kind of coarse cloth worn by mourners.
